slices.focus: Jae-hyun presents reliability metrics to company owner via wall charts.
slices.summary: After two quarters of sustained improvement, Kim Dong-wook asks Jae-hyun to present dispatch numbers to the company owner. Jae-hyun creates monthly wall charts with three categories: on-time departures within 20 minutes, avoidable misses, and handoff gaps by shift. The handoff-gap section shifts the room, giving misses a visible cause rather than making them look like bad luck.
